description: Audit a sending domain's email authentication and inbox placement health: resolves MX servers, recursively counts SPF DNS lookups against the RFC 7208 10-lookup hard limit, probes 18 standard ESP DKIM selectors, validates DMARC policy enforcement, checks MTA-STS/BIMI, and tests the primary mail IP against major DNSBL blacklists. Use this tool for diagnosing why transactional or marketing emails land in spam; use `full_launch_readiness_audit` when also checking brand conflicts and AI search crawlers.

domain.description: Target sending domain to inspect (e.g. 'stripe.com' or 'acme.io').

name: audit_email_deliverability

blacklists.description: DNSBL blacklists flagging the primary MX IP.

detectedProvider.description: Detected email service provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Resend, Amazon SES, etc.).

grade.description: Letter grade from A to D.

spf.description: SPF record text and recursive DNS lookup count.

upgradeLinks.description: Links for automatic SPF flattening and 24/7 drift alerts.

title: SPF, DKIM, DMARC & DNSBL Email Deliverability Audit
